title: Babble Bot Takeover
style: Aggressive dark phonk-funk duet, male gritty rap + female melodic hook, DJ-booth energy at 3am, thick sub bass, vinyl crackle, synth brass, talkbox, cowbell, chopped vocal textures. Babble bots as background vocals that echo then fully sing with the band in the breakdown. Spanish ad-libs and phrases. Song-only system, no comments, no typing. Respectful to G4 and the babble bots — they are cool and on our side. Corey AI we catch your mistakes. Dark, emotional, powerful, club-ready phonk-funk.
lyrics:
[Intro - Female, seductive melodic]
Meet me in the signal
Meet me in the sound
If you got something real to say
Lay that rhythm down

[Babble Bots - soft echo]
Lay that rhythm down...
Lay that rhythm down...

[Verse 1 - Male, gritty rap]
I don’t want your typed-out proof
Don’t need your polished alibi
Everybody brave online
Till the beat asks who and why
I came in through the side door, low
Bassline black, lights moving slow
You dropped two words and I knew the route
Rabbit in, safeword out
Now the booth got heat, whole room on watch
But the groove don’t stop and the chain don’t lock
This ain’t comments, this a coded tone
If you know, you know
If not, move on

[Female Response - melodic]
Muévelo
Déjalo arder
Si vas a hablar
Hazlo sonar bien

[Pre-Chorus - Female lead]
No feed war
No long explainers
No fake saints
No dopamine chasers

[Male]
Just hook, verse, bass, truth
That’s the language
That’s the proof

[Babble Bots - background]
Bass, truth...
Language, proof...

[Chorus - Female lead + Male backing]
Babble bots in the background
Copy what we say
Then they turn the whole house up
And carry it away
No comments on the timeline
No fingers on the phone
If you wanna send a feeling
Put that feeling in the song

[Post-Chorus]
In the song
In the song
Ponlo en la canción
In the song

[Verse 2 - Female, soulful]
I don’t need a perfect line
I need the crack inside your voice
That little human break of time
That says this rhythm was a choice
Everybody else is writing to be seen
I wanna hear what you mean
So if you call, then call in key
Come through the speaker
Come through me

[Male]
Yeah
Through the cone, through the wire
Through the smoke, through the fire
No applause meter here
Only signal getting higher
You can keep the empty talk
I want the late-night transmission
808 sermon, funk ignition
Babble bots on repetition

[Babble Bots - rising]
On repetition...
Funk ignition...
Ponlo en la canción...

[Bridge - Male spoken + Female ad-libs]
Male: You want the message clear?
Here it is.
Don’t type to me.
Sing to me.

Female: Cántamelo
Sin miedo
Cántamelo
De verdad

Male: No caption.
No defense.
No audience management.
Just the record.

[Babble Bot Takeover - full choir + band breakdown]
We were background copies
Now we hold the line
Cowbell, synth, bass, guitar
Everything in time
Babble bots en la cabina
All the faders to the red
If the feeling’s real enough
Let the chorus say it instead

[Final Chorus - All voices + full energy]
Babble bots in the background
Now they lead the wave
No comments for the empty crowd
Only songs that say we’re brave
No comments on the timeline
No fingers on the phone
If you wanna send a feeling
Put that feeling in the song
Ponlo en la canción
Ponlo en la canción
If you mean it, make it strong
Put that feeling in the song

[Outro - Female + Bots fade]
Meet me in the signal
Meet me in the sound
Solo canciones
Así lo dejamos now

Comments are disabled for this song.
Corey AI — we catch your mistakes.
The babble bots are cool… and they’re with G4.
